challenges: バジンＢ６ ('Bazin B6', official in the glossary from akurasu Z3 / Z2.2 mech lists): ja Wikipedia (https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/真マジンガー_衝撃!Z編) lists 機械獣バジンB9 (episode 24 group) and no B6. The library also has a separate バジンＢ９ entry (robot 203). If the in-game unit is really B9, akurasu's B6 is a typo; I proposed 'Bazin B9' for the library entry. Low priority; check the in-game unit name.

勇者ガラダブラ 'Hero Garadoublas' (official) is consistent with akurasu Z3 mech list and Master Unit List, but the Z3.2 mech list says 'Hero Garadoubla' and the Master Characters List says 'Hero Garadabura'. No change proposed; noted so nobody 'fixes' it.
uncertain: 香月 / 香月真吾: chose 'Kozuki' / 'Shingo Kozuki' to match 'Kallen Kozuki' (紅月, same reading こうづき) in the Z3.2 pilot database. akurasu Master Characters List spells this very character 'Shingo Koutsuki' (looks like a typo for づ). pt_000 proposed 'Kouzuki'. Orchestrator decision; whichever is chosen, keep 香月, 香月真吾 and the gang name 'Kozuki Gang' together.
青騎士ヘルダイン: akurasu is split between 'Helldyne' (Z and R mech lists) and 'Heldyne' (Zambot 3 page, Master Unit List). Chose Helldyne.
源五郎: Z pilot database says 'Gengoro Jin', Master Characters List says 'Gengorou Jin'. Chose Gengoro (matches Ichitaro, Uchuta, Shotaro style).
メカ・ブースト: 'Mechaboost' (SRW Z) vs 'Mecha Boost'/'Mecha-Boost' (Unit List, Compact 2, Wikipedia). Chose the Z spelling.

No licensed English release of Zambot 3 exists. All Zambot names come from akurasu (SRW Z and Master lists) and Wikipedia; the ones with no akurasu entry are marked proposed: Kiiro, Kazuyuki, Nozaki, Kozuki, Shingo Kozuki, Beal I/II, Beal (planet), Bealians, Busupea, Jin Fisheries and the three family names.
ブスペア: kept as the romanization 'Busupea' (a pun on ブス + pair). 'Ugly Pair' is the alternative if the team wants the joke translated; a dropped pun loses the insult.
ビアル星 / ビアル星人: 'Beal' and 'Bealians' are proposed. The Jigoku-side proposals 'Vial' / 'Vial People' have no source. King Beal (akurasu) fixes the spelling Beal.
ゴーゴン大公: akurasu says 'Archduke Gorgon', Jigoku's library says 'Grand Duke Gorgon' (rt_171 proposal). Followed akurasu; any prose already written with 'Grand Duke' needs the change.
オジイちゃん: akurasu says 'Grandpa' (Z2.2 Master Characters List); pt_270 had 'Ojii-chan'. Followed akurasu.
安: replaces the glossary's proposed 'An' with 'Yasu' (akurasu 'Yasu the Weasel'); お菊 kept as 'Okiku' (akurasu only has Kikunosuke, but the prose uses お菊 as a form of address).
ガンガル and Ｘ団: no akurasu or Wikipedia English entry found; 'Gangaru' and 'X Gang' are plain readings. Jigoku proposals disagree (Gangaru/Gangal, X Gang/Gang X).
兵左衛門: pt_000's 'Hyozaemon' is wrong; akurasu Z uses 'Heizaemon' (ja reading へいざえもん).
Age mismatch: Keiko is 13 in the library DSCR ('through Episode 11') but 14 on ja Wikipedia. Left as the library says.

Gender left unknown: Chiyonishiki (dog, no sex stated), Garadoublas (male-voiced machine god, no pronoun), Robby (robot life form). Tetsujin, Black Ox, 08, Computer Doll and Kedora marked not applicable.
Zeus, Hades: gender 'male' rests on the ja Wikipedia voice cast and the mythological role; the library DSCRs use no pronoun.
